analysis: The code calls matcher.group(1) and matcher.group(2) only after matcher.matches() returns true, ensuring a successful match has occurred. Therefore, IllegalStateException (which requires no prior match or a failed match) is avoided. However, the pattern ENCRYPTED_PATTERN is not shown; the code assumes groups with indices 1 and 2 exist. If the pattern does not define at least two capturing groups, calling group(2) will throw IndexOutOfBoundsException. This condition is not checked or validated in the code.
answer: IllegalStateException: avoided (match succeeded). IndexOutOfBoundsException: not avoided (pattern may lack group 2).
remark: IndexOutOfBoundsException is thrown if the pattern does not have a capturing group at index 2. The code does not validate the existence of group 2 before calling matcher.group(2). If ENCRYPTED_PATTERN has fewer than two groups, this exception will occur.
